shots.title: THE DEAD: a suburban street
shots.caption: Bones lying in the open on a suburb street, bleached and scattered by ten years of scavengers. RUN tab.

shots.title: THE DEAD: the road out
shots.caption: The exodus road. Remains on the asphalt where people stopped walking. RUN tab.

shots.title: THE DEAD: the walk-out
shots.caption: Open desert. The ones who walked out and did not make it, thin and scattered, no mummified bodies because nothing out here is sealed. RUN tab.

shots.title: THE DEAD: how thick they lie
shots.caption: A wider view of the same ground, so the density reads. Too many, too few, or about right is the only call needed. RUN tab.

shots.title: THE VISTA: the mountain overlook
shots.caption: THE DEMO MONEY SHOT. Stand on the west rim and the whole valley is laid out below you, drawn by the valley view that already existed. RUN tab, on reaching the overlook.

shots.title: THE PIT: the cemetery
shots.caption: They stopped digging graves and dug one hole. The cemetery is a dumping pit now, about 34 bodies in a single heap. RUN tab.

shots.title: A CLUSTER: they died together
shots.caption: The dead come in groups now, not sprinkled one by one. This is what you find in an abandoned block. RUN tab.

shots.title: A PIT DUG IN THE DIRT
shots.caption: Somebody dug here. The ground is sunk where the fill settled, the pale heap beside it is the earth that never went back in, and the dark green is growing on what is under it. Bare dirt and sand generate these now. RUN tab.
